branch: system/task_started with a description the tool line already shows
provenance: INFERRED, and deliberately narrow. The task lifecycle is not sub-agent-only: in CLI 2.1.226 the emit site sits among `runningSubagents`, `isBackgrounded`/`is_backgrounded` and `local_workflow`/`workflowName` (read with `strings -n 8` on ~/.local/share/claude/versions/2.1.226), and a user screenshot showed an ordinary Bash whose description was repeated verbatim under its IN/OUT box — which only taskLine can draw. The exact frame a backgrounded Bash emits was NOT probed live (these frames are never persisted, so there is no transcript to check), so the shape here is task_started minus the sub-agent-only fields, and the assertions stay at what the handler must do with the shape it is given: never print a line that only repeats the tool line above it, and never lose a line that says something new. Step 2 is the negative control — the same handler, one field different, must still draw.
